default.title: Personalized ClawPilot user guide
default.summary: Every active workspace membership now receives a private, continuously refreshed ClawPilot User Guide in Docs. It provides direct module navigation and role-aware instructions for projects and agents, pipeline and CRM, accounting and POS, sharing, mobile use, browser sessions, and troubleshooting.
features: A private ClawPilot User Guide automatically available as the first document for every active user membership
Direct links and concise workflow guidance for Dashboard, Docs, Projects, Pipeline, CRM, Accounting, POS, Links, Agents, and Versions
Workspace- and role-aware guidance for permissions, integrations, agent dispatch, controlled provider writes, browser sessions, and support evidence
Responsive guide reading in phone portrait, phone landscape, and desktop layouts
fixes: Provisioning no longer depends on a user first opening Docs or waiting for a background document refresh
Guide content remains current when a user's active workspace role or relevant permissions change
